i: tip

Howl of the Pack Leader: every 30 sec in combat, your next Kill Command summons a beast. The Wyvern raises your and your pet's damage by 10% for 12 sec; the Boar charges the target for heavy damage around it
tip

Stampede!: Bestial Wrath grants Howl of the Pack Leader, and your next Kill Command sends a stampede 30 yards straight ahead. It doesn't follow elevation and misses easily, so use it level with the enemies and not too far away (Wowhead)
tip
Hogstrider: when the Boar deals damage, your next Cobra Shot deals 100% more damage, and Cobra Shot hits up to 4 extra enemies based on how many the Boar hit
tip
Masterful Call extends Master's Call by 2 sec and gives the target 20% movement speed
tip
On Wowhead's build table, the raid, M+, and Delve ★ are all on Pack Leader
tip
Use Black Arrow (10 sec) only on enemies above 80% or below 20% health. Deathblow from Soul Drinker resets its cooldown and removes the health requirement
tip
Bleak Powder: Black Arrow explodes in an 8-yard cone behind the target. Shoot an enemy at the front of the pack to hit several (Wowhead)
tip
Using Bestial Wrath grants Withering Fire (10 sec, Black Arrow fires at 2 extra nearby enemies) and Wailing Dead (summons a Dark Hound; Wailing Arrow usable for 15 sec)
int
Wailing Arrow is a 1 sec cast that interrupts and silences the target and enemies within 8 yards for 1 sec. In M+ it doubles as an AoE interrupt (Wowhead)
tip
With Dire Cleave, the Dark Hound and Dire Beast come out with Beast Cleave, so time Bestial Wrath for when adds spawn (Wowhead)
tip

Bestial Wrath · 30 sec (reduced by 1 min via The Beast Within) · Instant heavy damage; you and your pet deal 20% more damage for 15 sec. Use on cooldown. Your pet must be hitting the target for the Bloodshed bleed to apply (Wowhead)
tip
Barbed Shot · 18 sec, 2 charges · 12-sec bleed, generates Focus over 8 sec. Use it 3 sec before Bestial Wrath or before reaching 2 charges
tip
Wild Thrash · 8 sec · Your pet hits all enemies within 10 yards (300% more damage on 2+ targets). Grants Beast Cleave for 10 sec after use
tip
Primal Rage · 6 min · 30% party Haste for 40 sec (Bloodlust-type, Sated). It's a pet ability
tb
Aspect of the Turtle · 3 min · For 8 sec, all spells and attacks miss you and you take 30% less damage, but you can't attack
tb
Survival of the Fittest · 1 min 30 sec · You and your pet take 30% less damage from all sources for 6 sec
tb
Exhilaration · 1 min 30 sec (Natural Mending) · Restores 30% of your health and 100% of your pet's, plus 12% more over 8 sec via Rejuvenating Wind
tb
Feign Death · 30 sec · Drops enemy threat. Emergency Salve removes poisons and diseases on you
int
Counter Shot · 24 sec · 40-yard ranged interrupt, 5-sec school lockout. Both M+ builds take it
int

Intimidation · 1 min · Your pet stuns the target for 5 sec (Guttural Roar also stuns nearby enemies for 1 sec). Binding Shot · 45 sec · Tethers enemies within 5 yards, stunning them for 3 sec if they leave. Freezing Trap · 30 sec · Incapacitates the first enemy to approach for 1 min. Bosses are immune to all of these
tip
Tranquilizing Shot · 10 sec · Removes 1 Enrage and 1 magic effect from an enemy. Kodo Tranquilizer also removes 1 magic effect each from 2 nearby enemies
pos
Disengage · 20 sec · Leap backward; Posthaste clears roots/snares and grants 50% movement speed for 4 sec. Aspect of the Cheetah · 3 min · 90% movement speed for 3 sec, then 30% for 9 sec
disp
You have no ally dispel. Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle + Emergency Salve clear only poisons and diseases on you. Free allies from roots and slows with your pet's Master's Call (45 sec)
tip

Pet family abilities: Master's Call, Mortal Wounds (reduces enemy healing received for 10 sec), Primal Rage. Wowhead recommends a Cunning pet with Mortal Wounds in dungeons with heavy enemy healing. The second pet from Animal Companion doesn't use family abilities
tip
Devour week: heal through it fast with Exhilaration. Wowhead also mentions Feign Death + Emergency Salve, and Master's Call (Masterful Call) on allies
int
Ascendant week: handle multiple orbs at once with Intimidation (Guttural Roar), and a single one with Freezing Trap (Wowhead)
pos
Pulsar week: you can use every ability while moving, so keep up damage while going to collect orbs
tip
Voidbound week: swap to the Void Emissary as soon as it spawns and kill it fast with Bestial Wrath (Wowhead). Level 12+ Xal'atath's Guile: 15 sec lost per death

pack-leader.title: Pack Leader points
items: Trigger {Stampede!} with {Kill Command} while level with the enemies and not too far away. If enemies are about to die or move, delay your burst slightly
Don't let {Kill Command} sit at 2 charges, and fit as many {Nature's Ally}-buffed {Kill Command}s as possible into burst windows

dark-ranger.title: Dark Ranger points
items: The Dark Hound ({Dire Cleave}) summoned during burst boosts AoE damage, so time it for when adds spawn
{Wailing Arrow} (use within 15 sec) interrupts enemies within 8 yards, so if interrupts are short, time it for pack casts

[광역 피해] Line up Survival of the Fittest with Ravenous Stomp's group damage (Topicx)
[해제] Regurgitate is a Disease. If it hits you, trigger Emergency Salve with Feign Death to clear it yourself

[광역 피해] When Uncoil splits the boss into five Writhes, press Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash with Bloodlust. If the group has no Bloodlust class, use your pet's Primal Rage here. Tether any Writhe moving toward its Spiteful Hunt target with Binding Shot (Topicx·Wowhead)

Zul'jan: [위치] Take a Ritual of the Fang beam for about a second, then Feign Death and stay in its path to stop that beam from firing (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest during the beam-soak channel, when the group uses its defensives (Topicx)
[회피] Do not have Aspect of the Turtle up when you deliberately clip an Axegrinder axe to clear Ritual Venom, since every attack misses you and the axe will not hit (Topicx·tooltip)

Lightblossom Trinity: [광역 피해] When the three bosses are stacked, use Wild Thrash on cooldown to keep Beast Cleave up (Wowhead)
[회피] If you are targeted by Thornblade, cancel it with Feign Death or block the bleed with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[차단] Kezkitt's Light Bolt does not need a kick rotation. Kick it when Counter Shot is available (Topicx)
Ikuzz the Light Hunter: [해제] If rooted by Bloodthorn Roots, free yourself with Disengage (Posthaste), and free rooted allies with your pet's Master's Call (Wowhead)
[회피] If targeted by Bloodthirsty Gaze, gain distance with Aspect of the Cheetah
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for Thorncaller Roar
Lightwarden Ruia: [차단] Put Counter Shot into the rotation for Moonkin Form's Warden's Wrath
[회피] The Pulverizing Strikes mark can be canceled with Feign Death (Wowhead)
[참고] If hit by Grievous Thrash, heal up with Exhilaration to clear the bleed fast; if you see it coming, block it with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
Ziekket: [참고] Don't use Aspect of the Turtle while stepping on multiple Lightbloom's Essence. You won't get the Lightbloom's Might damage increase (Wowhead)
[차단] Before the rez, interrupt the Lashers' Lightspore Shot with Counter Shot, and if they're grouped, stop them together with Intimidation (Guttural Roar)
[광역 피해] When the Lashers group up, turn on Beast Cleave with Wild Thrash to cleave them along with the boss

The Hoardmonger: [해제] When Toxic Spores poison stacks up, Feign Death to trigger Emergency Salve and clear it yourself (Wowhead)
[위치] If many mushrooms are left, turn on Aspect of the Turtle and step on several at once (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for Ravenous Bellow
Sentinel of Winter: [차단] Put Counter Shot into the Winter's Shroud rotation for the Fractured Shivercores, and stop a missed cast with Intimidation

[위치] As ranged, take the Fractured Shivercore away from the boss and send your pet to it too, so both adds die at the same time (Topicx). If you are the Rimeshatter soaker, get there within 6 sec with Aspect of the Cheetah
[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest during the Frozen Tempest Frost DoT
Nalorakk: [위치] With Aspect of the Turtle up during Fury of the War God, you can body-block several Echoes without gaining Spectral Slash (Wowhead)
[위치] If Echoing Maul targets you, use Disengage and Aspect of the Cheetah to reach a corner this set has not used within 4 sec, and press Survival of the Fittest as the Echo lands (Topicx)
[광역 피해] Take the three Overwhelming Onslaught Physical hits behind Zul'jarra's shield, and press Survival of the Fittest with it if a charge is left

Kystia Manaheart: [광역 피해] Save Bestial Wrath for Destabilized, and move Hunter's Mark each time you switch targets (Wowhead)
[차단] Clean up the Mirror Images clones with Counter Shot, Intimidation, and Freezing Trap (Wowhead)
[참고] While Kystia's health is high she has many Felshield stacks, so don't use Wild Thrash (Wowhead)
Zaen Bladesorrow: [광역 피해] Line up Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash with the second Bloodlust as the fight starts with the worker pack after the RP. If the group has no Bloodlust class, use Primal Rage. Remove Keen Taskmaster's Back to Work! Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot, and stop low-health Warehouse Workers running away with Binding Shot or Freezing Trap (Topicx·Wowhead)
[회피] If there is no barrel to hide behind, block Murder in a Row with Aspect of the Turtle (Wowhead)
[광역 피해] Killing Spree is armor-ignoring Physical damage, so press Survival of the Fittest
Xathuux the Annihilator: [광역 피해] Have Bestial Wrath ready when Demonic Rage increases the boss's damage taken by 30% (Wowhead). The third Bloodlust goes on the second Demonic Rage, so press Primal Rage here if the group has no Bloodlust class (Topicx)

[우선 처치] When the Axe Toss axe drops, switch to the axe and send your pet with the pet attack command (/petattack)
Lithiel Cinderfury: [차단] Put Counter Shot into the Chaos Bolt kick rotation
[광역 피해] Use Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash when the Furious Vilefiend and Wild Imps appear, not on the boss. Drop Binding Shot on Wild Imps gathered by Fingers of Gul'dan (Topicx)
[회피] Pop Aspect of the Turtle to cross Malefic Wave safely (Wowhead)

Taz'Rah: [광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest for Dark Bloom Shadow damage
[회피] Use Disengage to dodge Void Fissure orbs; you can use every ability while moving, so don't stop damaging

[우선 처치] Bloodlust goes on the first Toxic Creeper, so press Primal Rage here if the group has no Bloodlust class (Topicx). Send your pet to the Creeper with the pet attack command (/petattack) and Kill Command, and use Bestial Wrath on the Creeper

Mchimba the Embalmer: [차단] Put Counter Shot into the kick rotation for the Half-Finished Mummy and Finished Mummy Wretched Discharge

[제어] Tether the intermission Infused Whelps with Binding Shot so they hit allies with Cold Claws less often (Wowhead)
Kokia Blazehoof: [차단] Put Counter Shot into the rotation for the Blazebound Firestorm's Blaze Volley

781.m: 사정거리 없음 · 즉시 · 20 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
781.d: 뒤로 물러납니다. [급가속: 이동 방해 효과가 제거되고, 이동 속도가 4초 동안 0%만큼 증가합니다] [위기 모면: 거미줄 덫을 놓아, 8미터 반경 내의 모든 대상이 끈적이는 거미줄에 걸려 8초 동안 이동하지 못하게 만듭니다]

982.d: 야수가 기본 생명력의 100%를 지닌 채 되살아나게 합니다.

5384.d: 적을 속여 자신이 죽은 것처럼 보이게 만듭니다. 최대 6분 동안 지속됩니다.

19574.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간
19574.d: 시전자와 야수가 광폭해져 대상에게 즉시 (전투력의 800%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 또한 15초 동안 시전자와 야수의 모든 공격력이 20%만큼 증가합니다. 야수에게 걸린 모든 군중 제어 효과를 제거합니다. [피의 향기: 야수의 격노 활성화 시 날카로운 사격이 0회 충전됩니다]

19577.m: 특성 · 100 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 1 분 재사용 대기시간
19577.d: 적을 위협하도록 야수에게 명령합니다. 5초 동안 대상을 기절시킵니다.

19801.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간
19801.d: 적에게서 1개의 격노 효과와 1개의 마법 효과를 제거합니다.

34026.m: 특성 · 집중 30 · 50 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 7.5 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
34026.d: 야수에게 살상 명령을 내려 적에게 돌진해 흉포하게 (전투력의 247.2%)의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다.

109215.d: 철수 사용 시 모든 이동 방해 효과가 제거되고, 이동 속도가 4초 동안 50%만큼 증가합니다.

109248.m: 특성 · 30 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
109248.d: 마력이 담긴 투사체를 발사하여 투사체로부터 5미터 반경 내의 적들을 10초 동안 구속합니다. 적이 화살에서 5미터 이상 떨어질 경우 3초 동안 기절시킵니다. [억제의 족쇄: 구속의 사격으로 기절 상태가 된 대상의 효과가 사라지면 8초 동안 대상에게 받는 피해가 10%만큼 감소합니다]

109304.m: 45 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 2 분 재사용 대기시간
109304.d: 자신의 생명력이 30%만큼, 야수의 생명력이 최대 생명력의 100%만큼 회복됩니다. [원기 회복의 바람: 활기 시전 시 8초에 걸쳐 최대 생명력의 12.0%만큼 추가로 생명력을 회복합니다]

115804.d: 대상에게 심각한 상처를 입혀 10초 동안 받는 치유 효과를 감소시킵니다.

115939.d: 마구잡이 난타 후 다음 10.0초 동안 야수의 근접 공격이 추가로 주위에 있는 모든 적에게 70%만큼의 피해를 입힙니다. [살상의 회전베기: 추가로 살상 명령이 주위에 있는 모든 적에게 70%만큼의 피해를 입힙니다] 대상이 8명을 초과하면 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

120679.d: 출혈 효과로 피해를 입히면 4%의 확률로 강력한 야생의 야수를 유인해 8초 동안 대상을 공격하게 합니다. (500밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

147362.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 24 초 재사용 대기시간
147362.d: 주문 시전을 차단하고 5초 동안 같은 계열의 주문을 시전하는 것을 방해합니다.

186257.d: 3초 동안 이동 속도가 90%만큼 증가합니다. 효과가 만료되면 추가로 9초 동안 이동 속도가 30%만큼 증가합니다.

186265.d: 8초 동안 모든 주문과 공격이 빗나가고, 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다. 단, 공격할 수 없게 됩니다.

187650.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 30 초 재사용 대기시간
187650.d: 목표 위치로 냉기 덫을 발사합니다. 적이 다가오면 1분 동안 행동 불가 상태로 만듭니다. 대상이 피해를 받으면 효과가 사라집니다. 한 번에 하나만 사용할 수 있으며, 덫은 1분 동안 지속됩니다.

193455.m: 레벨 90 · 특성 · 집중 35 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시
193455.d:
빠르게 사격하여 [(전투력의 390.4%) * ((최소(90 - 1, 19) * 12 + 112) / 340)]의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.
살상 명령의 재사용 대기시간이 1초만큼 감소합니다.

199530.d: 날카로운 사격을 시전하면 야수가 발을 굴러 주위의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 144%)의 물리 피해를 입힙니다.

217200.m: 특성 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 18 초 재사용 대기시간 · 2회 사용 가능
217200.d:
적을 관통하며 찢어발기는 사격을 가해 12초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 85.7%) * 5]의 출혈 피해를 입힙니다. 날카로운 사격을 다시 부여하면 남은 피해량을 새로운 날카로운 사격 효과에 합산합니다.
8초에 걸쳐 (5 * 8 / 2)의 집중을 생성합니다.

259558.d:
대상에게 사냥꾼의 징표를 겁니다. 사냥꾼은 징표에 걸린 대상을 항상 볼 수 있고, 추적할 수 있습니다.
사냥꾼의 징표는 대상이 받는 피해를 3%만큼 증가시킵니다. 한 번에 한 대상에게만 부여할 수 있습니다.

264667.d:
40초 동안 모든 파티원과 공격대원의 가속을 30%만큼 증가시킵니다.
효과를 받은 아군은 만족함 상태가 되어 10분 동안 원초적 분노 또는 유사 효과를 받지 못합니다.

264735.m: 특성 · 사정거리 없음 · 즉시 · 1.5 분 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
264735.d: 6초 동안 자신과 야수가 받는 모든 피해가 30%만큼 감소합니다.

267116.d: 야수 부르기가 우리에 있는 추가 칸에서 야수를 추가로 소환합니다. 이 야수는 살상 명령에 복종하지만 야수 종류 능력을 사용할 수는 없습니다.

272682.m: 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 45 초 재사용 대기시간
272682.d: 야수가 자신 및 아군 대상 1명에게 걸린 모든 이동 불가 및 이동 방해 효과를 제거하고, 4초 동안 야수와 대상이 유사한 효과에 면역이 됩니다.

378207.d: 야수의 회전베기가 활성화된 동안 살상 명령 사용 시 주위의 적을 추가로 공격해 입힌 피해의 20%에 해당하는 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

392060.m: 집중 15 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 1 초 주문 시전 시간
392060.d:
마력 깃든 화살을 발사하여 대상에게 (전투력의 1400%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 대상의 8미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게는 (전투력의 700%)의 추가 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 울부짖는 화살에 적중당한 플레이어가 아닌 대상은 주문 시전을 방해받고 1초 동안 침묵 상태가 됩니다.
죽음의 강타를 부여합니다.

430709.d:
활기 시전 시 3초 동안 적자생존이 부여됩니다.
적자생존이 50%의 효율로 활기를 활성화합니다.

459517.d: 죽은 척하기 및 거북의 상 사용 시 독과 질병 효과를 제거합니다.

459730.d:
광포한 야수를 8번 소환할 때마다 용맹의 뿔피리를 불어 하티 또는 펜리르를 소환해 전투를 돕게 합니다.
하티
모든 야수의 공격력을 4%만큼 증가시킵니다.
펜리르
주 대상에게 달려들어 강력한 출혈 효과를 걸어, 8초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 800%)의 피해를 입히고 사냥꾼의 가속을 4%만큼 증가시킵니다.

459983.d: 평정의 사격이 2명의 주위 대상에게 걸린 최대 1개의 마법 효과를 추가로 제거합니다.

466930.m: 특성 · 집중 10 · 40 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 10 초 재사용 대기시간 · 1회 사용 가능
466930.d: 부상당한 대상에게 최후의 일격을 시도해 (전투력의 348.4%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 추가로 8초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 400%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 생명력이 80% 이상이거나 20% 미만으로 떨어진 적에게만 사용할 수 있습니다.

466990.d:
야수의 격노 시전 시 어둠을 받아들여 10초 동안 부패의 사격과 죽음의 강타가 부여됩니다.
부패의 사격
검은 화살을 시전하면 주위의 대상에게 2발의 검은 화살을 30%의 효율로 연이어 발사하며, 검은 화살의 지속 피해 효과에 영향을 받지 않는 적을 우선적으로 공격합니다.

467911.d: 검은 화살이 충돌 시 폭발해 어둠과 유황으로 이루어진 구름을 생성해 대상 후방 8미터 부채꼴 범위 내의 모든 적에게 (전투력의 250%)의 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다. (700밀리초 재사용 대기시간)

469638.d:
살상 명령 사용 시 20%의 확률로, 날카로운 사격 사용 시 50%의 확률로 죽음의 강타가 부여됩니다.
죽음의 강타
검은 화살의 재사용 대기시간이 초기화됩니다. 다음 검은 화살은 대상의 현재 생명력에 상관없이 모든 대상에게 사용할 수 있습니다.

469880.d: 코브라 사격 시전 시 날카로운 사격의 재사용 대기시간이 2초만큼 감소합니다.

471876.d:
전투 중 30초마다 다음 살상 명령 사용 시 맹수를 소환하여 지원을 받습니다.
와이번
와이번이 하늘에서 내려와 전투의 함성을 내질러 12초 동안 사냥꾼과 야수의 공격력을 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.
멧돼지
멧돼지가 시전자의 대상에게 1회 돌진하여 주위의 적에게 (전투력의 1440%)의 피해를 입히고, 주 대상에게는 (전투력의 1200%)의 추가 물리 피해를 입힙니다. 5명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.
곰
곰이 전투에 난입해 적을 찢어발깁니다. 주위에 있는 최대 8명의 적에게 10초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 400%)의 피해를 입힙니다.

472550.d:
야수의 공격이 와이번의 공격력 증가량을 1%만큼, 최대 10%만큼 증가시킵니다.
살상 명령 시전 시 와이번의 지속시간이 0.5초만큼, 최대 5초만큼 연장됩니다.

472639.d:
멧돼지가 피해를 입히면 다음 코브라 사격의 공격력이 100%만큼 증가합니다.
멧돼지에게 피해를 받은 적 하나당 코브라 사격이 1명의 추가 대상을 공격하며, 최대 4번까지 유효합니다.

472741.d: 야수의 격노 시전 시 무리의 지도자의 포효가 부여되고 다음 살상 명령이 주위의 야생동물을 자극해 쇄도를 일으켜, 대상에게 돌진해 7초에 걸쳐 [(전투력의 150%) * 9]의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다.

1217524.d: 광포한 야수 소환 시 8.0초 동안 100%의 효율로 야수의 회전베기가 부여됩니다.

1232739.d:
광포한 야수가 살상 명령에 복종하며, 30%의 효율로 피해를 입힙니다.
야수의 격노 사용 시 광포한 야수가 분노에 사로잡혀 15초 동안 공격력이 10%만큼 증가합니다. 야수의 격노의 지속시간 동안 소환된 광포한 야수에게 적용되는 지속시간은 감소합니다.

1258509.d: 위협이 추가로 주위 적을 1.0초 동안 기절시킵니다.

1264290.d:
야수의 격노 사용 시 어둠 사냥개를 소환합니다.
야수의 격노 시전 후 15초 동안 야수의 격노가 울부짖는 화살로 대체됩니다.
울부짖는 화살
마력 깃든 화살을 발사하여 대상에게 (전투력의 1400%)의 암흑 피해를 입히고 대상의 8미터 내에 있는 모든 적에게는 (전투력의 700%)의 추가 암흑 피해를 입힙니다. 울부짖는 화살에 적중당한 플레이어가 아닌 대상은 주문 시전을 방해받고 1초 동안 침묵 상태가 됩니다.
죽음의 강타를 부여합니다.

1264359.m: 특성 · 집중 35 · 50 야드 사정거리 · 즉시 · 8 초 재사용 대기시간
1264359.d:
야수에게 명령을 내려 10미터 내 모든 적을 난타해 (전투력의 191%)의 물리 피해를 입히게 합니다. 마구잡이 난타가 2명 이상의 적에게 적중하면 300%의 추가 피해를 입힙니다.
8명을 초과하는 대상에게는 감소된 피해를 입힙니다.

1264690.d: 살상 명령 사용 시 어둠 사냥개가 어둠의 난타를 사용해 주위에 있는 최대 8명의 적에게 (전투력의 210%)의 암흑 피해를 입히게 합니다.

1265051.d:
날카로운 사격의 치명타 및 극대화율이 5%만큼 증가합니다.
코브라 사격의 치명타 및 극대화율이 15%만큼 증가합니다.

1268705.d: 주인의 부름의 지속시간이 2초만큼 연장되며, 대상의 이동 속도를 20%만큼 증가시킵니다.

1272099.d: 야수의 격노 사용 시 야수가 대상을 찢어, 12초에 걸쳐 (전투력의 1440%)의 출혈 피해를 입히도록 합니다.

1273126.d:
날카로운 사격과 코브라 사격의 공격력이 15%만큼 증가합니다.
날카로운 사격과 코브라 사격, 검은 화살 사용 시 다음 살상 명령의 공격력이 30%만큼 증가합니다.

1: [차단] Put Counter Shot (24 sec) into the kick rotation for Radiant Spellsower's Light Bolt Volley (4 sec cast, 174568 Holy).

[제어] When a Spellsower runs toward a dormant Lasher pack with Call The Grove, fire Binding Shot (45 sec) at its feet. It is stunned for 3 sec as soon as it moves 5 yards away, so it cannot start Frantic Blooming. If it has already started channeling, stop it with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun).

[광역 피해] Bloodlust once everything is stacked. If the group has no Bloodlust class, use your pet's Primal Rage (6 min) here together with Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash. Take Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret (87284 Holy every 2 sec for 6 sec) with Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor).
2: [차단] When both Radiant Spellsowers cast Light Bolt Volley together, kick one with Counter Shot and stop the other with Intimidation (5 sec stun). If they stand together, Guttural Roar also stuns the second Spellsower for 1 sec.

[우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher activates its Lightbloom Pollination shield (absorbs 600108, immune to crowd control), use Bestial Wrath on that Lasher to add the Bloodshed bleed and break the shield first.
[광역 피해] Use the remaining Survival of the Fittest charge on Spouting Floret. If both charges are spent, top yourself off with Exhilaration (1.5 min, heals 30% of health).
3: [제어] Keep both Radiant Spellsowers from running to the 12 Lashers with Call The Grove: fire Binding Shot while the two Spellsowers stand within 5 yards of each other to tether both.
[차단] Kick Light Bolt Volley with Counter Shot, and stop the other Spellsower's cast with Intimidation while Counter Shot is on cooldown.
[광역 피해] When the 12 Lashers are gathered on the tank, use Wild Thrash (8 sec) on cooldown to keep Beast Cleave up without gaps.
5: [광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Spouting Floret from the Sporeblight Belcher pulled first. Have Beast Cleave up with Wild Thrash before the Virid Grovekeeper joins 5-6 sec later.

[제어] When a Thorny Saptor jumps in with Thornclaw Leap, stop it with Binding Shot or Freezing Trap (30 sec) (Wowhead). If it has already started its cone attacks, stop it with Intimidation (5 sec stun).
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech (4 sec cast) with Counter Shot. If it goes off, the whole group is disoriented for 3 sec.
7: [참고] The Spiny Shield on the 5 Spineshield Beetles (absorbs 500090, reflects 4849 Nature to attackers) is a Magic effect. Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec) with Kodo Tranquilizer also removes Spiny Shield from 2 nearby Beetles (Wowhead).
[제어] If both Thorny Saptors stand within 5 yards of each other, tether both with a single Binding Shot to stop Thornclaw Leap. If only one is left, stop it with Freezing Trap.
[차단] Kick Lightfeather Petalwing's Disorienting Screech with Counter Shot, and kick Leafy Grovecrawler's Seed Shot too when Counter Shot is available.
8: [참고] Remove Spiny Shield from the 5 Spineshield Beetles by firing Tranquilizing Shot (3 Beetles at once with Kodo Tranquilizer) every 10 sec.
[제어] Tether both Thorny Saptors with Binding Shot or stop Thornclaw Leap with Intimidation. Guttural Roar also stuns the other Saptor for 1 sec.
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.
10: [해제] If Potatoad Matriarch's Toxic Spew (67888 Nature plus a 9 sec poison DoT) hits you, press Feign Death to clear the poison from yourself with Emergency Salve (a must-have utility per Wowhead). You cannot dispel the poison from other party members.

[제어] When a Newborn Potadpole hatched from an egg leaps in with its knockback (Potad-Toss, 2 sec cast), tether it with Binding Shot (Wowhead). Break the Potadpole Eggs together by activating Beast Cleave with Wild Thrash.
[우선 처치] When a Lightgorged Lasher activates Lightbloom Pollination, use Bestial Wrath on that Lasher, and if you brought a Cunning pet, reduce Pollen Surge healing with Mortal Wounds (Wowhead).
11: [차단] When all 3 Lightfeather Petalwings cast Disorienting Screech together, kick one with Counter Shot and stop the stacked rest with Intimidation (Guttural Roar stuns nearby enemies for 1 sec). The Dark Ranger build can interrupt every cast within 8 yards of the target at once with Wailing Arrow (1 sec cast), available for 15 sec after Bestial Wrath.
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Spouting Floret, and top yourself off with Exhilaration if no charge is left.
12: [우선 처치] The 6 Lightgorged Lashers activate Lightbloom Pollination one after another, so use Bestial Wrath (30 sec) on cooldown on the shielded Lasher and break the shield with Bloodshed. With a Cunning pet, put Mortal Wounds on that Lasher too.
[차단] Split the 2 Radiant Spellsowers' Light Bolt Volley between Counter Shot and Intimidation, and tether them with Binding Shot if they run off with Call The Grove.
[광역 피해] Use Survival of the Fittest on Sporeblight Belcher's Spouting Floret.

1: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss (4 sec cast, 135775 armor-ignoring Physical) with Counter Shot (24 sec).

[제어] When the seven Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed with Ravenous Claws, fire Binding Shot (45 sec) under the pack or stop their swings with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun) to drop the stacks (Wowhead). Guttural Roar also stuns nearby Descendants for 1 sec.

[해제] If Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots (48491 Nature every sec for 20 sec, 10% slow per tick) hits you, clear your slow with Disengage (Posthaste), and free allies with your pet's Master's Call (45 sec) (Wowhead).
2: [우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath (30 sec) on the Ritual Chieftain and keep your pet on it so the Bloodshed bleed lands too. Kick the Primal Serpent's Piercing Hiss with Counter Shot.

[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor) for Blood Sacrifice (87284 Physical to the whole group plus a 162029 heal absorb), then clear the heal absorb right away with Exhilaration (Wowhead).
3: [차단] When the three Primal Serpents walk down behind the pillar, kick one with Counter Shot, and if kicks run short, stop another Piercing Hiss with Intimidation (5 sec stun).
[광역 피해] Use the second Survival of the Fittest charge on Blood Sacrifice. If the heal absorb remains, clear it with Exhilaration (1.5 min).
4: [제어] When the four middle Ravenous Descendants stack attack speed, tether them with Binding Shot to drop the stacks, and line up Bestial Wrath on the Ritual Chieftain to kill it before several Blood Sacrifices land.
5: [광역 피해] This is the biggest pull at 103 trash. Press Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash (8 sec) together to keep Beast Cleave up while you melt the Ritual Chieftain first. Take Blood Sacrifice with Survival of the Fittest and clear the heal absorb with Exhilaration.
[해제] Clear the two Twinfang Harrowers' Paralyzing Shots slow from yourself with Disengage (Posthaste), and use Master's Call on an ally stacking the slow (Wowhead).
[차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Counter Shot.
7: [차단] Kick High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom (3.5 sec cast) with Counter Shot, and break Evolve (6 sec channel) with Freezing Trap (30 sec) or Intimidation to deny the shield and crowd-control immunity (Wowhead).

[해제] If Envenom's poison lands on you, press Feign Death (30 sec) to clear it with Emergency Salve (Wowhead). Clearing the DoT right before Rattle keeps it from overlapping with Rattling Writhe's Rattle (58189 armor-ignoring Physical every sec for 5 sec).
[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest for Rattle. With a Cunning pet, put Mortal Wounds on the Evolutionist casting Evolve to cut its healing (Wowhead).
8: [제어] When the four Bloodletters are stacked, use Intimidation on one of them. Guttural Roar stuns the nearby Bloodletters for 1 sec too, pausing their melee swings and blood pools.
[광역 피해] If no Survival of the Fittest charge is left for Rattle, top yourself off with Exhilaration to survive it.
9: [차단] Take the High Evolutionist left far to the left, since you are ranged. Kicking its Mass Envenom with Counter Shot makes the Evolutionist walk toward the pack.
[제어] Break the other Evolutionist's Evolve with Freezing Trap or Intimidation, and line up Bestial Wrath on the Evolutionists to kill them before the second Mass Envenom.
11: [차단] Kick your assigned High Evolutionist's Mass Envenom with Counter Shot. When several stacked Evolutionists channel Evolve, stop them together with Intimidation and Guttural Roar, and hold a separated one with Freezing Trap (Wowhead).
[차단] The Dark Ranger build interrupts every Mass Envenom within 8 yards of the target at once with Wailing Arrow (1 sec cast), available for 15 sec after Bestial Wrath.
12: [우선 처치] Ascendant Serpent must die before the third Infest, so use Bestial Wrath on this mini-boss on cooldown.
[광역 피해] When Infest hits you (34914 Nature every sec for 5 sec, then 69827 Nature within 8 yd), press Survival of the Fittest.
[제어] Tether the Hatchlings that hatch and fixate random players with Binding Shot (Wowhead).
13: [우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath on Ula'tek's Chosen, and do not press Wild Thrash while the six Living Venoms are low together, since Beast Cleave pops them all at once. Mass Envenom must be kicked every time, so save Counter Shot for the Chosen.

[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest for Toxic Surge (29095 Nature every sec for 9 sec), and during it hold the two Blades of the Altar with Intimidation (Guttural Roar) or Binding Shot to stop their Laced Edge teleports.
14: [광역 피해] If both Survival of the Fittest charges went into pull 13, top yourself off with Exhilaration at the end of Toxic Surge.
[제어] If the Intimidation (1 min) used on pull 13 is not back, tether the Blades of the Altar with Binding Shot during Toxic Surge.
15: [차단] Take one of the two Primal Serpents' Piercing Hiss with Counter Shot.
[해제] Clear Twinfang Harrower's Paralyzing Shots slow from yourself with Disengage (Posthaste) and use Master's Call on allies. Disengage also gets you out of the Toxic Breath frontal.
16: [우선 처치] Line up Bestial Wrath on Ula'tek's Chosen to kill it before the second Toxic Surge. Kick the Chosen's Mass Envenom with Counter Shot.

[광역 피해] The two Ritual Chieftains' Blood Sacrifices come back to back, so take the first with Survival of the Fittest and clear the heal absorb with Exhilaration after the second. If Toxic Surge overlaps too, survive it with Aspect of the Turtle (3 min, 30% damage reduction).

1: [광역 피해] This Bloodlust pull takes the Bribed Captain and the Bribed Guard together. If the group has no Bloodlust class, press your pet's Primal Rage (6 min), and use Bestial Wrath (30 sec) on the Captain to kill it first.

[해제] If Street Sneak's Heartstop Poison (5% max health reduction per stack plus a Nature DoT) stacks on you, press Feign Death (30 sec) to clear it with Emergency Salve. You cannot dispel the poison from other party members.
[제어] When a Row Hooligan tries to leap onto a party member with Cutpurse, stop it with Binding Shot (45 sec) or Freezing Trap (30 sec) (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Each of the two Seductive Sayaads' Seduction (3 sec cast, 6 sec disorient) gets one kicker. Kick yours with Counter Shot (24 sec), and stop it with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun) if Counter Shot is down.
[회피] If Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles (Fire every sec for 5 sec) targets you, cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead).
3: [제어] Stop the two Row Hooligans' Cutpurse with Binding Shot, and cancel Felonious Mage's Fel Missiles with Feign Death (Wowhead).
4: [해제] With four Street Sneaks, Heartstop Poison stacks fast. If it stacks on you, trigger Emergency Salve with Feign Death, and if it stacks again within 30 sec, survive it with Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor).
5: [우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath on the Massive Felwyrm, and when Massive Fel Detonation (5 sec cast, 290947 Fire within 10 yd) starts before it dies, get outside the radius with Disengage.

[광역 피해] When Burning Fel (38793 Fire within 50 yd every 3 sec from Over-infused) piles up, press Survival of the Fittest. You cannot remove Corroding Spittle (Magic), so leave it to a party member who can.
[제어] Stop the four Row Hooligans' Cutpurse with a single Binding Shot while they are stacked (Wowhead).
8: [우선 처치] Shivan Punisher deals Fire damage to the group with Demonic Frenzy until it dies once it drops below 50%, so hold Bestial Wrath until just before 50% and melt it in one go. Press Survival of the Fittest if Demonic Frenzy damage piles up.
[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Counter Shot, and with a Cunning pet put Mortal Wounds on the Health Funnel target (Wowhead).
[참고] If Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage (60% damage reduction, crowd-control immunity) was not kicked, remove it with Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec) (Wowhead).
9: [회피] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, break it with Feign Death (Wowhead). If you take it, the Warlock heals a lot. With a Cunning pet, put Mortal Wounds on the Warlock.
[참고] Remove the two Wrathguard Flayers' Fel Rage with Tranquilizing Shot, and tether a Demon Fly with Binding Shot when it tries to Fel Dash (Wowhead).
10: [차단] Kick the first Health Funnel from the two Fel Invokers with Counter Shot, and stop the other with Intimidation.
[우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath once Shivan Punisher drops below 50%, and when the eight Demon Flies are gathered, hit them together by activating Beast Cleave with Wild Thrash (8 sec).
11: [우선 처치] Kill Felmaster Lucsei with Bestial Wrath before it casts Blade Dance more than three times.
[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest as your personal defensive for Blade Dance (Fire group damage), and top yourself off with Exhilaration (1.5 min) if no charge is left for the next Blade Dance.
13: [광역 피해] Use Bestial Wrath on the Defiled Golem and press Survival of the Fittest for Defiled Slam (145474 Fire to everyone). Hit the packs dragged onto the imps together with Wild Thrash.
[참고] Kick Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Counter Shot, and remove it with Tranquilizing Shot if missed.
14: [광역 피해] Activate Beast Cleave with Wild Thrash when the six Unleashed Imps are gathered. The Dark Ranger build interrupts every imp's Felfire Burst within 8 yards of the target at once with Wailing Arrow (1 sec cast), available for 15 sec after Bestial Wrath.
[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Counter Shot, and remove Wrathguard Flayer's Fel Rage with Tranquilizing Shot.
15: [회피] If Corrupted Warlock's Drain Life targets you, break it with Feign Death (Wowhead). Use Bestial Wrath while killing the Warlock first, and line up the next Bestial Wrath on the Shivan Punisher below 50%.
[광역 피해] If the Punisher's Demonic Frenzy and Curse of Doom damage overlap, press Survival of the Fittest, and survive it with Aspect of the Turtle (3 min, 30% damage reduction) if no charge is left.
16: [광역 피해] Pool Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash on the Defiled Golem so its AoE ends within two casts, and press Survival of the Fittest for Defiled Slam.
[차단] Kick Fel Invoker's Health Funnel with Counter Shot. Get out of Fel Beam quickly with Disengage.

1: [참고] The two Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath is an Enrage effect. Fire Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec) on cooldown to remove it (Wowhead). If you are the only soothe in the group, keep it rolling for this whole pull.

[광역 피해] This is the first Bloodlust pull. If the group has no Bloodlust class, press your pet's Primal Rage (6 min), and use Bestial Wrath (30 sec) on the Starvation Effigy totem first to break it before the second Insatiable Hunger stack.

[제어] When a Keen-Eyed Striker tries to jump in with Razor Dive, stop it with Binding Shot (45 sec) or Freezing Trap (30 sec) (Wowhead). If Spirit of Hunger's Feast of Misery (38793 Shadow every sec) hits you, break the drain on yourself with Feign Death (30 sec) (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze (3.5 sec cast) with Counter Shot (24 sec) first, and kick Earth Bolt when Counter Shot is available. With a Cunning pet, put Mortal Wounds on the Tender to cut the healing from any Healing Breeze you miss (Wowhead).
[참고] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot.
3: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Counter Shot.
[우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath on the Starvation Effigy totem, and remove the Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Tranquilizing Shot.
4: [제어] When the three Keen-Eyed Strikers try to use Razor Dive, tether them together with one Binding Shot while they are stacked. Stop a separated one with Freezing Trap (Wowhead).
[참고] Remove Territorial Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Tranquilizing Shot, and break Feast of Misery with Feign Death.
5: [차단] Kick Earthwhisper Tender's Healing Breeze with Counter Shot, and remove the Matriarch's Mother's Wrath with Tranquilizing Shot. You can still fire Tranquilizing Shot from 40 yards while the tank drags this pack to the boss spot.
7: [광역 피해] This is the cooldown pull after the boss. Once everything is gathered in the corner, press Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash (8 sec) together and keep Beast Cleave up.
[참고] Mother's Wrath stacks on the two Territorial Matriarchs, so alternate Tranquilizing Shot between them every 10 sec (Wowhead).
[차단] When both Earthwhisper Tenders cast Healing Breeze together, kick one with Counter Shot and stop the other with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun).
8: [참고] Remove the two Territorial Matriarchs' Mother's Wrath with Tranquilizing Shot. Frostfang's Bloodrush has no dispel type, so you cannot remove it (Wowhead spell page).

[우선 처치] Terra Rumbler's Rumbling Ward shield cannot be removed, so break it fast with Bestial Wrath. If the 24246 Nature pulse every 2 sec drains you while the shield is up, press Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor).
9: [광역 피해] This is the second Bloodlust pull. If the group has no Bloodlust class, press Primal Rage and line up Bestial Wrath on the Terra Rumbler's shield.

[차단] Kick Frigid Mauler's Frigid Roar (3.5 sec cast) with Counter Shot. If it goes off and you get the 50% movement slow, clear it with Disengage (Posthaste) and use Master's Call (45 sec) on allies (Wowhead).
10: [차단] Split the two Frigid Maulers' Frigid Roar: kick one with Counter Shot and stop the other with Intimidation (5 sec stun). This is the cooldown pull after Bloodlust, so use Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash together.
11: [우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath on the Avatar of Determination first, then focus the Terra Rumbler's shield.
[해제] Free an ally trapped in Glacial Tomb with your pet's Master's Call, and break out yourself with Disengage (Posthaste) (Wowhead). Stand outside Pulverize (4 sec cast, 12 yd stun) with Disengage.
13: [차단] Take one of the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning (4 sec cast, 193965 Nature) with Counter Shot.
[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest for Grizzled Warbringer's Primal Echo (stacking armor-ignoring Physical), and use Bestial Wrath on the Ruthless Totemcaller's Magma Totem first.
14: [참고] The Bestial Wrath that the three Bonded Beasttamers put on their pets (25% more damage for 10 sec) is an Enrage effect. Remove it with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead).
[우선 처치] Kill the two Ruthless Totemcallers' Magma Totems first, and kick Stormbound Mystic's Arc Lightning with Counter Shot. If the group uses its third Bloodlust here, press Primal Rage with it.
15: [광역 피해] The four Grizzled Warbringers take turns casting Primal Echo, so take the first with Survival of the Fittest, the second with the remaining charge, and the third with Exhilaration (1.5 min) or Aspect of the Turtle (3 min, 30% damage reduction).
[차단] Split the two Stormbound Mystics' Arc Lightning between Counter Shot and Intimidation, and remove Bonded Beasttamer's Bestial Wrath Enrage with Tranquilizing Shot.
16: [차단] Put Counter Shot into the kick rotation for Loa Speaker Nanea's Lightning Bolt. If Counter Shot is not back, stop the cast with Intimidation.
[우선 처치] When Volatile Totems appear, line up Bestial Wrath on a totem and hit all three with Wild Thrash. If the group uses Bloodlust here on high keys, press Primal Rage with it.

1: [광역 피해] This Bloodlust pull takes the whole first corridor up to the Voidtouched Magi. If the group has no Bloodlust class, press your pet's Primal Rage (6 min), and use Bestial Wrath (30 sec) and Wild Thrash (8 sec) together.

[차단] Take one of the two Enthralled Shamans' Lava Bolt with Counter Shot (24 sec). If you are assigned the second kick on Voidtouched Magi's Shadowbolt Volley, save Counter Shot for it and use Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun) on the Shaman.

[참고] Remove Dominated Brawler's Bloodsurge and Longtooth Tuskarr's Bolster with Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec), and tether a Feral Saberon with Binding Shot (45 sec) when it tries to Savage Leap (Wowhead). If Null Eruption targets you, step away from the group and press Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor).
2: [우선 처치] When Raj'kess the Spellstorm summons the three Orb of Disruption orbs, switch to the orbs immediately and send your pet with the pet attack command (/petattack). If the orbs are close together, hit them all with Wild Thrash.

[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest for Thundering Storm (long group damage), and top yourself off with Exhilaration (1.5 min) if you are low when it ends. Stand apart from the group so Forked Lightning does not bounce.
3: [광역 피해] This is the big room at 158 trash. Press Survival of the Fittest for Chitigoth's Insidious Aura (87284 Nature to everyone every 2 sec for 10 sec), and use Bestial Wrath on Brutok when it hits a wall and is stunned for 5 sec by Concussion.
[제어] Tether the Protective Turtle with Binding Shot so its Shell Guard cannot reach the pack, and stop the five Feral Saberons' Savage Leap with Binding Shot while they are stacked (Wowhead).
[참고] Remove Raging Raptor's Feral Rage and Longtooth Tuskarr's Bolster with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead). Clear Angry Krolusk's Violent Sand slow (40%) from yourself with Disengage (Posthaste).
5: [차단] Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek (3.5 sec cast, 6 sec fear within 60 yd) is the most important kick in this area. Save Counter Shot for it, and stop it with Intimidation if missed.
[회피] If Watchful Harrower's Void Beam (43642 Shadow every 0.5 sec for 4 sec) targets you, cancel it with Feign Death (30 sec) (Wowhead). Everyone gets into the Sky Strike circle to share it.
6: [우선 처치] Line up Bestial Wrath on Brutal Overseer's Brutal Slams shield to break it fast. If the Physical damage that grows 10% per slam overlaps with a Sky Strike soak, press Survival of the Fittest.
[회피] If the Overseer's Macestorm or Watchful Harrower's Void Beam targets you, cancel it with Feign Death (Wowhead). Remove Dominated Brawler's Bloodsurge with Tranquilizing Shot.
8: [우선 처치] Switch right away to the low-health mob that Devouring Brutalizer targets with Devour (9 sec cast). With a Cunning pet, put Mortal Wounds on the Brutalizer to cut Devour's healing (Wowhead). This is the cooldown pull, so use Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash together.
[광역 피해] Press Survival of the Fittest for Dreadbellow (knockback, 29095 Shadow every sec for 12 sec, cannot be dispelled).
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Counter Shot first, and kick Voidminder's Mending Void when Counter Shot is free or cut its healing with Mortal Wounds.
9: [광역 피해] When the ten Scavenging Siphoids are gathered, activate Beast Cleave with Wild Thrash. If no Survival of the Fittest charge is left for Dreadbellow, top yourself off with Exhilaration.
[차단] Kick Kilivore Screamer's Mad Shriek with Counter Shot, and stop Enthralled Shaman's Lava Bolt with Intimidation.
10: [회피] If Watchful Harrower's Void Beam targets you, cancel it with Feign Death, and press Survival of the Fittest for Dreadbellow. If neither is back, survive with Aspect of the Turtle (3 min, 30% damage reduction).

[우선 처치] Use Bestial Wrath on the Devouring Brutalizer to kill it before its next ability, and cut Voidminder's Mending Void healing with Mortal Wounds. Stop Feral Saberon's Savage Leap with Binding Shot (Wowhead).

1: [참고] The Minion of Zul on the way die when their Bound by Shadow (Magic shield) is removed. Fire Tranquilizing Shot (10 sec) at a stunned Minion of Zul, and Kodo Tranquilizer removes the shield from 2 nearby Minions too (Wowhead).

[광역 피해] This is the first pull, so Bloodlust here. If the group has no Bloodlust class, use your pet's Primal Rage (6 min) together with Bestial Wrath and Wild Thrash. Take each Shadow Whirlwind from the Shadow-Borne Champion (4 sec cast, 164870 Shadow to the whole group) with Survival of the Fittest (1.5 min, 2 charges with Padded Armor).
[참고] When the Shadow-Borne Champion activates Ancestral Fury (Enrage, +150% damage done), remove it right away with Tranquilizing Shot (Wowhead).
2: [차단] Kick Risen Hexer's Hex Volley (3.5 sec cast, 116379 Shadow plus a 12 sec curse DoT) with Counter Shot (24 sec), and stop casts while Counter Shot is on cooldown with Intimidation (1 min, 5 sec stun).

[광역 피해] This is a cooldown pull, so press Bestial Wrath. Use your remaining Survival of the Fittest charge on Shadow Whirlwind, and top yourself off with Exhilaration if no charge is left. Remove Ancestral Fury with Tranquilizing Shot.
